info.name: DR-CTL-003 - CTL Missing Check
info.description: Requests exercising the DR-CTL-003 ("CTL missing check") validation rule against POST /api/validation/validate, including the ctlShortCodes bypass path via a CCII result line.

request.description: DR-CTL-003 defaults to enabled=false in the validation_rule table (see V1.003__insert_dr_ctl_001.sql). Run this once against a live instance before the requests below, otherwise the rule is skipped and no warning is ever produced regardless of payload.

item.name: Warning triggered - RI with no CTL

request.description: No CTL short code and no existing CTL record on the offence, and the offence is not convicted -> DR-CTL-003 WARNING is expected on off1.

item.name: Warning suppressed - CCII short code present in resultLines

request.description: CCII is one of the configured ctlShortCodes in DR-CTL-003.yaml. A CCII result line recorded against the same offence in the current hearing satisfies the CTL-present bypass condition, so DR-CTL-003 should NOT fire (0 warnings).
